mentions.name: Ashdomes
mentions.description: A slow, real-time multiplayer strategy game inspired by Neptune's Pride and Subterfuge, where each game tick takes an hour and matches can last over a week. Currently in closed alpha.
mentions.problem: There were few titles in the slow real-time strategy genre of Neptune's Pride and Subterfuge, and the creator wished there were more.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A slow, realtime strategy game similar to Neptunes Pride and Subterfuge.

Each game tick is an hour and games can last over a week. I got hooked on both Subterfuge and Neptunes Pride and always wished there were some more titles in this genre.

Currently in closed alpha.
